description: This Java class 'WallpaperActivity' extends the Android 'Activity' class. It demonstrates how to create an activity with the system wallpaper behind it by setting its content view to a specific layout resource during the onCreate lifecycle method.

classes.name: WallpaperActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a layout with the system wallpaper as the background.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets its content view to a specific layout resource.
